audience: home inspection companies that book inspections and track agent referrals in Spectora

useCases.title: See this week's bookings and open slots
useCases.text: List inspections for a date range, filtered by status or inspector. Find open inspector slots for a service to offer a real time to a client.

useCases.title: Rank agents by referrals
useCases.text: Get referral and inspection statistics per agent for a scorecard. Open one agent to read the details behind the numbers.

useCases.title: Find inspections by location
useCases.text: List inspections filtered by location, date range, status or service. Open one inspection to read it, with related records when you ask for them.

useCases.title: Add a new client without duplicates
useCases.text: Search the clients first, then create a new client record with its details. Each create call adds a new record, so search first.

useCases.title: Correct a client's details
useCases.text: Open a client, then update only the fields you send. The client email cannot be changed here.
